I am Hasana - one of but a few authorized equipment and materiel quartermasters for the Dawn.$B$BAs you fight evil under our commission - all the while earning our respect and trust - you'll earn valor tokens from Officer Garush.  Tokens serve two purposes: use them to gain increased standing within our ranks, or use them as tender in acquiring special items.$B$BAs you improve your standing with the Dawn, you'll discover that more items will be made available to you.

Make sure that you begin your descent by detaching your "wings" at the right time to land in the water, or, well, I don't sell life insurance.
